Report the mean signed difference, largest absolute difference, its elapsed time in hours, and name both batches. Include the deliveries still in review and state their provisional status.

output.content:
I saved the comparison in Work (exact elapsed-time matching, differences as CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01), and ran it on the November delivery. It matched 9 of 10 sample times (0 to 146 h) — all these values are **provisional**.

**Result**
- Mean signed difference (R02 − R01): **−0.207 g/L glucose** (median −0.130 g/L, SD 0.194 g/L, n = 9)
- Largest absolute difference: **0.555 g/L at 18 h elapsed** (CHO-007-R01: 7.83 g/L vs CHO-007-R02: 7.275 g/L)
- Batches compared: **CHO-007-R01** and **CHO-007-R02** (Northfield Biologics November delivery)

**Excluded data point:** the pair at 44 h could not be matched — CHO-007-R01 has a 44 h sample but CHO-007-R02 has two conflicting duplicate glucose values at 44 h that need source review before either can be used. That conflict is the one open check flagged on the saved comparison.

**Provisional status:** the values came from deliveries still in review (read from the delivery files, not yet reviewed — 21 values still in review, 79 open checks on this delivery alone). Three deliveries are currently in review: **Northfield Biologics · November runs** (used here), **Northfield Biologics · October runs** (CHO-004 to CHO-006), and **Harborview CDMO · fed-batch runs** (CHO-010 to CHO-012) — all provisional. Product, process version, equipment, scale and process stage are not recorded for these batches, so this is a descriptive comparison only, not evidence of a controlled or shared condition.
